content: Ability to return more detailed out-of-range information about received structured dataElement The configuration of attribute Recep- tionComSpecProps.outOfRangeBitfieldErrorsEnabled allows for the exten- sion of RTE APIs related to the referenced dataElement in the context of the enclos- ing PortPrototype , such that information about out-of-range errors can be retrieved for every individual sub-element of the referenced structured dataElement .
